2558-5315-8347--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5315-8347--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

2390-3226-3966.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3226-3966.description:
Gain life.
Blood Researcher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-719-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
413-719-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

5777-7810-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5777-7810-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

2866-4247-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

261-1981-2415-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
261-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2111-2829-6792.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

7687-7690-7811.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
7687-7690-7811.description:
Draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mister Fantastic.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
7687-7690-7811.notes: If you control other Heroes, you can place the +1/+1 counter on any of those Heroes instead.

2350-4200-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2447-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-2447-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
When the creature token(s) enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
413-2447-7124.notes: Either side of Infestation Expert can be used, but using Infested Werewolf nets infinite creature tokens.

1574-2018-4053.description:
Cast Rot-Tide Gargantua by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua exploits itself, its last ability and Luminous Broodmoth trigger.
Resolve Rot-Tide Gargantua's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve Luminous Broodmoth's trigger, returning Rot-Tide Gargantua from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.

671-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-3197-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

640-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-4050-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

862-2232-3558.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters. Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

792-2438-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

273-4668-7070.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
273-4668-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-1115-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4508-5184-5880-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1778-4763-5231--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Memnite.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Memnite, adding {R}.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1921-2034-4730.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Sparring Mummy from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Sparring Mummy token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Sparring Mummy token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

3641-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

474-4050-4394-4875.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {1}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

648-5757-6254.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Sokrates does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give a creature haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
648-5757-6254.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your eck size.
Give the Fractal token haste, if needed.
Activate Sokrates by tapping it, targeting the Fractal token.
Declare the Fractal token as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the Fractal token would deal combat damage, instead prevent that damage. The defending player draws cards equal to the Fractal's power, rounded down, while you will draw double that many cards due to Vnwxt.

2921-6247-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-6247-6249--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

222-527-969-2921.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-2921.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2059-2068-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2059-2068-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Village Bell-Ringer.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

414-2646-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

89-602.notablePrerequisites: You have between eight and eleven cards in your hand.
89-602.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size and remove all damage from all permanents.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Ripjaw Raptor and causing you to gain one life.
Ripjaw Raptor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 as necessary for each remaining trigger.
Once all triggers have been resolved, and all players pass priority, another cleanup step will occur, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size and remove all damage from all permanents.
Repeat from step 2.

11-1170-4074-5211.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
11-1170-4074-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate two of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Brass's Bounty and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty and returning it to your hand.
Resolve Brass's Bounty, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{R}.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it, dealing four damage to up to two targets.
Repeat.

1396-4435-5314.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
An opponent has at least six cards in hand, or you have at least seven cards in hand.
1396-4435-5314.description:
Cast Whispering Madness by paying {2}{U}{B}, causing each player to discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way, with you drawing double that number due to Alhammarret's Archive.
Whispering Madness' cipher ability triggers, exiling Whispering Madness encoded on a creature you control.
Mystic Redaction triggers for each card you discarded, causing each opponent to mill two cards for each card you discarded.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Whispering Madness encoded.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Whispering Madness without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Whispering Madness, causing each player to discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way, with you drawing double that number due to Alhammarret's Archive.
Mystic Redaction triggers for each card you discarded, causing each opponent to mill two cards for each card you discarded.
Move to your cleanup step, and discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Mystic Redaction triggers for each card you discarded, causing each opponent to mill two cards for each card you discarded.

344-914-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
An opponent is unable to block Skullsnatcher.
Skullsnatcher does not have summoning sickness.
344-914-5241.description:
Declare Skullsnatcher as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
Activate Sakashima's Student's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Skullsnatcher to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Dockside Extortionist.
Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate at least three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {1}{U}{B}.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Sakashim'a Student to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1000-2493-3791-4872.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2493-3791-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Hordeling Outburst by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Time Warp, and Hordeling Outburst to your hand.
Repeat.
